query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('94bca9c099e84ffd90d150316bb44c31a78702239076a0a80ea4a469', '84967d911e1a10d5b4a38441879f374a07f340945bcf9e7697485255')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
